summary: Cinder turn-based HUD: class/threat selection and transitions, field guide, first-person/isometric view badge, automap/tactical grid, action points/intents, AP hover preview, pack filters/drop, forge, NPC dialogue, boons and weapons.
useWhen: Present Cinder's class/threat choice, discrete turns, field guide, AP hover preview, fogged map/grid, pack/forge/NPC overlays and keyboard boon choices.
limitations: Consumes the Cinder family service; pointer-locked play uses keyboard selections. Desktop keyboard/mouse controls; automap is hidden on narrow screens while the tactical grid remains available. Camera-mode chrome is presentation-only and depends on an optional ViewModes service.
